text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day, and the atmosphere
is
electric with excitement as students
happily
exchange chocolates with each
other.
Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Teach. I'm comin' in!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, considering what day it is, there's
only one
thing I could be here for!
choice_data_list: What's the matter, all of a sudden?
What is it, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So, take this! Thanks for everything,
Teach!

I unwrap and open the box she gives me
to find a
collection of beautiful
chocolates of various
shapes and sizes.

I can't help but wonder where she
bought them
from, but when I ask her
out of curiosity...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, I made them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
They're a real hit back at the dorm.
Guess I've
gotten better at making 'em
over the years.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I had a pretty tough time makin' the
rose-shaped
ones last year, but I pulled
through this time
around.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And this one is... well, a chocolate
portrait of the
two of us!

She points to the chocolate in question,
and when
I look at it, I see that it really
does bear a striking
resemblance to us.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Doesn't it just? I had to use a
bunch of
tiny chisels to make it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Fuji told me she didn't even realize it
was made of
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, not that that matters or anything!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're gonna love how the chocolates
taste,
guaranteed! If you're ever feelin'
tired, you can
have a nibble on 'em to
fuel yourself up.

Before I dig into the box, I make sure to
get a
good photo of the gorgeous
chocolates.

I unwrap and open the box she gave me
to find a
chocolate gateau garnished
with whipped cream
inside.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Have a taste, Teach!

I take a bite and am rewarded with the
cake's
smooth, moist texture. The
bottom layer of the
slice is crammed
with crunchy walnuts.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Great. Hehe. I'm glad to hear it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You'd never guess it, but this is actually
my
special healthy chocolate gateau! It's
low in sugar
and fat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I used tofu instead of fresh cream and a
sugar
substitute instead of cane sugar. I
caramelized
the walnuts in maple syrup
too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Chocolate is surprisingly calorie dense,
so I
thought it'd be better to make it
healthier.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm just relieved that you find it
tasty.
Phew...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What? Hm... Well, I was just wondering
why I feel
relieved in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Normally when people say they enjoy my
food, I
just want them to eat as much as
they'd like, but
right now I...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Hmmm?! What the heck's going
on with
me?!

Her sudden personal crisis aside, it's
clear how
much work she put into
making a cake for me,
and my heart
warms at the thought.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What? Why? I made that for you to eat.
choice_data_list: Let's eat together, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Th-the heck? You're kinda pushy today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess it wouldn't be so bad to
eat
together once in a while. I'll go make
us some
coffee.

We enjoy an elegant break with some
warm,
freshly-brewed coffee and
delicious cake.
